cases.summary: Through the bridge: in a running status turn the owner appends user text, assistant commentary with a tool call, a user record mixing text and the tool result, and a final answer; the append result (the agent.records_appended payload) and a records read carry the same ids, order, phases, turn stamps and the result-to-call link; after the root reports idle the turn reads ended with outcome completed and an end time from that report, while reasoning stays null.

cases.summary: A terminal_screen source is invalid_params at params.source before any service runs; a registered agent whose session is an opaque provider id and never reported records is conversation_unavailable naming not_reported with records provenance and its session, and a plain shell names no_agent; a tool result that answers no call is invalid_records at its call_id and appends nothing; commentary in a still-working turn reads with no outcome, no end time and no final phase.
